proof_summary: Take the counterexample \(N=2^{14}\cdot4409\cdot458009\), whose three factors are pairwise coprime prime powers. Using \(a(N)=2\sigma(N)-\sum_{d\mid N}\sigma(d)\) and multiplicativity gives \(\sigma(N)=66183576284700\) and \(\sum_{d\mid N}\sigma(d)=132367152569399\), so \(a(N)=1\) although \(N\ne1,12\).
